$comment: The root pyrightconfig.json declares extraPaths: ["."] relative to the
repository root. Some servers, including the one used by the pi-lens check,
take the test file's own directory as their root and never read the root
config, so "extraPaths" resolves to tests/ and every project import is
reported unresolved. Standalone pyright reads the root config and reports
zero errors, and the modules import correctly at runtime.
Declaring the parent here fixes the file's own directory case without
repeating anything the root config already says.
